technical.summary: WAB shows solid bullish technicals with price above all key MAs and MACD/Stoch crossovers, but weak trend strength (ADX 12.69), overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), and lack of volume confirmation limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: WAB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 23 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Ro Khanna's consistent selling pattern over 6 months provides mild bearish signal, but lack of senior/large-scale congressional activity, neutral market sentiment, and absent news data prevent strong conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (193.28) indicates extreme market stress, earnings in 23 days adds binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD/Stoch bullish crossovers provides technical setup, and support at 98.83 offers defined risk entry point for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 193.28), high earnings risk in 23 days, overbought momentum (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend conviction, zero fundamental/smart money support, and congressional selling create compounding risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above MAs with MACD/Stoch bullish crossovers, but this is insufficient to justify entry given severe macro headwinds and earnings binary event in 23 days.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (193.28), inverted yield curve recession signal, and earnings announcement in 23 days create compounding macro and event risk that overwhelms technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction; technical score (7) is isolated and outweighed by fundamental (3), sentiment (5), and risk (1) consensus
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding WAB position with 24 existing Industrials positions (4.8% sector concentration); adding to concentration during macro crisis and earnings window is imprudent.
